title: Checks for imports of the telnetlib module.
summary: Telnet is considered insecure. It is deprecated since version 3.11, and was removed in version 3.13. Instead, use SSH or another encrypted protocol. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-bandit. It is in preview.
message_templates: `telnetlib` and related modules are considered insecure. Use SSH or another encrypted protocol.

title: Checks for imports of the ftplib module.
summary: FTP is considered insecure. Instead, use SSH, SFTP, SCP, or another encrypted protocol. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-bandit. It is in preview.
message_templates: `ftplib` and related modules are considered insecure. Use SSH, SFTP, SCP, or another encrypted protocol.

title: Checks for imports of the pickle, cPickle, dill, and shelve modules.
summary: It is possible to construct malicious pickle data which will execute arbitrary code during unpickling. Consider possible security implications associated with these modules. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-bandit. It is in preview.

title: Checks for imports of the subprocess module.
summary: It is possible to inject malicious commands into subprocess calls. Consider possible security implications associated with this module. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-bandit. It is in preview.

title: Checks for imports of the xml.etree.cElementTree and xml.etree.ElementTree modules.
summary: Using various methods from these modules to parse untrusted XML data is known to be vulnerable to XML attacks. Replace vulnerable imports with the equivalent defusedxml package, or make sure defusedxml.defuse_stdlib() is called before parsing XML data. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-bandit. It is in preview.
message_templates: `xml.etree` methods are vulnerable to XML attacks

title: Checks for imports of the xmlrpc module.
summary: XMLRPC is a particularly dangerous XML module, as it is also concerned with communicating data over a network. Use the defused.xmlrpc.monkey_patch() function to monkey-patch the xmlrpclib module and mitigate remote XML attacks. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-bandit. It is in preview.

title: Checks for imports of wsgiref.handlers.CGIHandler and twisted.web.twcgi.CGIScript.
summary: httpoxy is a set of vulnerabilities that affect application code running in CGI or CGI-like environments. The use of CGI for web applications should be avoided to prevent this class of attack. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-bandit. It is in preview.
message_templates: `httpoxy` is a set of vulnerabilities that affect application code running inCGI, or CGI-like environments. The use of CGI for web applications should be avoided

title: Checks for imports of several unsafe cryptography modules.
summary: The pycrypto library is known to have a publicly disclosed buffer overflow vulnerability. It is no longer actively maintained and has been deprecated in favor of the pyca/cryptography library. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-bandit. It is in preview.
message_templates: `pycrypto` library is known to have publicly disclosed buffer overflow vulnerability

title: Checks for imports of the pyghmi module.
summary: pyghmi is an IPMI-related module, but IPMI is considered insecure. Instead, use an encrypted protocol. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-bandit. It is in preview.
message_templates: An IPMI-related module is being imported. Prefer an encrypted protocol over IPMI.
